title: Will and Confession
author: B. M. Thornbury
blurb: Silas Eriksen, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
